purpose: Publish a public dashboard showing weekly library visit totals per city. No individual-level analysis is requested.
requirements: The weekly total number of library visits for each city.
The city name associated with each weekly total.

fields.description: An aggregate table with one row per city per week, containing the city name and total number of library visits for that week. No individual records or identifiers.
Email addresses of individual visitors. Contains no city names, visit counts, dates or aggregate totals.
Staff birth dates only. Contains no city names, visit counts, dates of visits or aggregate totals.
